themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously, such as data gathering, analysis, and even problem-solving.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the use of AI-generated personas or user simulations to test designs and gather insights without real human participants.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights specific AI-powered platforms and software designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is directly integrated into the design and research process to enhance creativity, efficiency, and output.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles detailing studies and investigations into the behavior, capabilities, and societal impact of AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that analyze customer data to derive insights, personalize experiences, and drive business decisions.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discusses platforms and environments designed to facilitate and scale AI research activities.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, creating new positions, and affecting the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
